alert_rule.consequential: First permitted notification matching frozen active descendant closure.
alert_rule.fail: Ratio greater than 1, any false positive/negative in exact-set acceptance, or repair consisting only of bulk acknowledgment fails P1.6. This chosen tolerance is not observed human preference.
alert_rule.unit: Unique (change_id, recipient, affected managed output) notification requiring attention; repeated prompts for the same triple count as unnecessary. Delivery retry without another prompt is not another alert.
alert_rule.unnecessary: False-positive output or repeated prompt; missing required alerts reported separately.
alert_rule.zero_denominator: 0/0 is 0; positive/0 is infinity; report counts beside ratio.

arms.equipment: Per-institution Git repos, standard-library workflow glue, R121 current-status pulls, signed actors/grants/statuses, dependency register and citation bounds/packet membership/claim binding/expiry checks. Implement equivalent capture, lease, shared draft, repair, proof interfaces and automation; existing tested crypto primitives may be reused in both.
Document client, Kyoei workspace and agent adapter; Git not required to participate.
Same Kyoei clients/authority, optional read-only committed-blob adapter.

comparison.failure: Never hide an unimplemented or failing reference path; report it and withhold superiority on that measure until equipment matches.
comparison.falsifier: If reference requires no more application code/configuration/recovery and matches throughput/failures, report tie and apply MRD market/scope gate. Do not add mechanism to create a gap.
comparison.reference_first: Implement, qualify and record reference values with source/config/trace hashes before executing measured Kyoei arms. Identical host budgets, payloads, fault ordering, actors, trust roots, automation and proof guarantee; no extra reviewer. Exclude warm-up from both. Record run order and machine load; no population inference from one-host timing.

equivalence.deny_all: Successful baseline, repaired output, local draft and unrelated-use controls mandatory.
equivalence.normalization: Only explicit source locators and generated request/signature/timing fields may differ. Compare aliases via digest map, sorted set-valued fields, stable refusal codes. Do not discard arbitrary IDs, reasons, dependency structure or authorization fields.

interface_rule: Scenario actions only via workspace CLI and one agent adapter; driver must not import stores, sqlite/database libraries or edit databases. A separate evaluator may inspect snapshots read-only for graph/secret-leak audits. Fault injector is separate, labelled and limited to fault cases; its calls never count as participant workflow.

lifecycle.amendment: Never edit v1 in place. Create a versioned successor with rationale and new digest before collecting affected data; retain and report v1 results and deviations.
lifecycle.archive: Local bytes and code pin only; not committed/pushed or externally timestamped by this freeze. Record external archive separately if later authorized.
lifecycle.reports: Every subsequent Priority 1 report contains contract_digest, source digests, arm, source mode, freshness mode, environment, raw event/timing paths, deviations and missing fields. Missing is null, never zero.

limits: One host/operator controls simulated institutions; separate keys/stores are not independent administration.
Signatures do not establish human expertise or legal authority.
Declared unmanaged inputs and copied plaintext are outside capture; revocation is not erasure.
D-1 is not D-2 proof delivery, and P1.0 is neither.

application_code.exclusions: Fixtures, tests, measurement harness, declarative config and installed third-party crypto implementations excluded from adopter lines but listed separately by digest/version/license and supplier size where available. Equal crypto dependency in both arms. Report supplier code so moving code into a library cannot be called total complexity reduction.
application_code.inventory: List each authored executable file by role, SHA-256, arm, maintained-by and logical lines. Kyoei adopter adapters/glue count; reusable Kyoei runtime is supplier code reported separately. Reference includes all workflow, policy, federation, copied/reused R121 glue beyond Git/stdlib. Shared adopter files count in full in each arm once, not once per institution. Identical renamed/copied blobs deduplicate by digest within an arm. Do not omit generated maintained logic.
application_code.rule: Parse Python with ast without execution; tokenize source. Count each nonempty logical NEWLINE segment and each semicolon-separated nonempty segment. Ignore blank/comment/indent/dedent/NL tokens. Multiline strings including docstrings count once. One-line suites count once per semicolon segment. All executable/config glue must be Python for a comparable total; otherwise report unsupported separately and no total advantage.

concurrent_throughput.timing: Barrier release starts cell timer; end after all completions/timeouts. Latency from client dispatch including queueing, IPC/status/locking to final result; report all-attempt and successful latency separately. p50/p95 are nearest-rank sorted observations ceil(p*n), null when n=0. Throughput is successful expected results / wall seconds; report attempted throughput, errors, conflicts and timeout counts. Report five cell values and median; never silently retry/drop failures. Also record CPU time, peak RSS method, bytes and status fetch count.
concurrent_throughput.workload: Separate retrieval-only and mixed workloads; mixed each actor repeats [retrieve, local-draft, retrieve, shared-draft-CAS] five times after warmup. Each CAS uses observed head; conflicts are reported, never dropped. Fresh isolated fixture per cell/arm/repetition. Fixed B issuer delay before each response outside DB; concurrency across distinct requests permitted. Same 19-node fixture, below the current 1024 cap.

configuration_burden.commands: Count every top-level setup client invocation from empty persistent state through first exchange, including failures/retries. Internal RPCs counted separately; no batching hides decisions. Machine setup time uses perf_counter_ns from first setup process start to first successful exchange; report cached dependency setup separately, no human-time substitution.
configuration_burden.rule: A decision is each named user-chosen semantic field required before first successful exchange: per institution count credential/trust pin/endpoint/store/delegation/release/retention/terms values by distinct config key, even when a template fills them. Derived identifiers and fixed invariant defaults are not decisions; record them. List shared choices separately and count full shared choices in each arm, not multiply by three.

dependency_coverage.coverage: Automatic supported retrieval/derivation paths separate from manually declared/imported paths. Denominator authored before implementation, never regenerated by capture. Attempt bypass via undeclared copy explicitly reports unmanaged/out-of-coverage, not a successful capture.
dependency_coverage.ratio: TP/expected; empty expected is null with counts, never 100%. Pass requires exact expected edges on supported paths, zero unauthorized edges, zero bypasses. Shared expected graph is evaluator-only; validate B-local release bindings without exporting private graph.
dependency_coverage.rule: Frozen expected edges are directed (child,parent,kind). Count use and release-binding edges separately on each active snapshot. TP=observed intersect expected; missing=expected minus observed; extra=observed minus expected. Unauthorized means edges exposing/consuming outside grants; extra legitimate declared relations are reported separately, never silently unioned into capture.
dependency_coverage.unit: edge counts and ratio per source path

operational_failures.rule: Each frozen fault class has positive and negative control, repeated 3 times per arm/source/freshness condition. Report expected and actual allowed/denied, wrongly blocked valid uses, obsolete/unauthorized accepted uses, lost updates, disclosure leaks, crash/timeouts, duplicate effects and recovery outcome. Missing case is null/not-run, never pass.
operational_failures.staleness: Count owner-withdrawn local uses inside unseen valid leases separately as bounded stale local use; never report zero stale use from zero obsolete exchange. Zero unauthorized or obsolete exchanges, zero lost updates and zero prohibited disclosures required.
operational_failures.unit: counts by fault class and consequence

recovery_steps.constraints: No bulk acknowledgment masquerades as repair; zero revived withdrawn use. Count shared-draft rebase/retry and file-exchange reference steps by same rule.
recovery_steps.rule: For each injected fault count all client actions after fault injection through first permitted repaired use, including failed attempts, acknowledgment, replacement request, re-derivation and assessment. Fault injection/restart infrastructure are separately counted; automatic background repair requests count as machine actions. Compound client action counts once but list its semantic transitions/RPCs. Unrepaired state is null with attempted count, never zero.

predictions.prediction: Equipped reference and Kyoei tie; zero unauthorized/obsolete exchange on supported paths.
Kyoei is slower per strict read; R121 prior medians 32.3 vs 15.6 ms are context, not new measurements.
Possible advantage in adopter code/configuration/recovery, not guaranteed; report ties and losses.
Git and documents produce identical semantic outcomes.
Local-only drafting continues during outage; lease reduces valid refusals but admits bounded staleness; strict exchange remains mandatory.
CAS prevents lost updates; whether it reduces steps/code versus exchange is unknown.
Unmeasured; no productivity, independent quality, market demand or institutional-independence inference.

proof_profile.crypto_qualification: Proof system, library/version, commitment construction, circuit/verifier digests, setup assumptions and cryptographic review are NOT SELECTED by P1.0. Freeze a supplemental implementation profile before D-2 prover code or result collection; both arms use the same guarantee. An attestation/mock never satisfies P-06.
proof_profile.delivery: D-2; D-1 returns unsupported and cannot pass P-06.
proof_profile.leakage: Public profile bounds and success (n>=8), hiding commitment and approved release context; exact n, rows and blinding remain private. One fixed k per table version per purpose; owner refuses adaptive threshold requests.
proof_profile.predicate: The committed table has 8 <= n <= 16 rows; every active row satisfies S1; inactive slots canonical padded; row IDs strictly increasing. Does not prove real-world uniqueness, correctness, clinical validity or the released aggregate computation.
proof_profile.task: C may mark assessment proof-qualified only after verifying this predicate, exact context and current release authority; failure/unsupported defers that task. D-1 non-proof diagnostic analysis is visibly separate.
proof_profile.witness: B-local ordered table, row count, padding and fresh secret commitment blinding; no raw row/guessable-value hash is an acceptable hiding commitment.

scope: P1.0 only: prospective contract, not D-1 execution, product evidence or externally archived preregistration.
